brief:
Several British universities have discussed pro-Palestine campus protests with BAE Systems, the defence contractor, according to Al Jazeera English. The briefings raise questions about the weapons manufacturer's influence over academic institutions and potential threats to campus activism and free speech.

The details of these conversations between university officials and BAE Systems representatives have sparked concern among advocates for academic freedom and Palestinian solidarity movements on campuses.
dek: Several universities discussed protests with the weapons maker, raising concerns about influence and academic freedom.
title: UK universities brief arms maker on pro-Palestine protests
